name: Linkup
desc: Linkup is a web search engine for AI apps. Connect your AI application to the internet and get grounding data to enrich your AI's output.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search the web for relevant content based on a natural language query. Perfect for grounding LLM responses with factual data.

actions.name: fetch
actions.description: Fetch a webpage and convert it to markdown format. Optionally render JavaScript, include raw HTML, or extract images.

guides.title: Linkup automation
guides.excerpt: Read our quick guide on Linkup automation. Discover how it works, explore common use cases, and learn how Activepieces can help.

guides.title: AI in IT: Use Cases and Applications for IT Operations
guides.excerpt: AI in IT means using machine learning, NLP, and automation to detect issues, resolve incidents, and cut downtime across IT operations.
